q: Under sail you meet a vessel with these shapes, towing nets. Who gives way?
answer: You — sail keeps clear of a vessel engaged in fishing
why: Rule 18: sail gives way to fishing, NUC and RAM.

figure.note: Two cones apexes together: vessel engaged in fishing

ru.Two cones apexes together: vessel engage: Два конуса вершинами вместе: судно, занятое ловом рыбы

q: You are anchored in a busy bay by day. What do you hoist?
why: Rule 30: ball by day, all-round white light at night.

q: You are under sail and converging with a ship showing these shapes. Who keeps clear?
answer: You — she is not under command
why: Rule 18: sail keeps clear of a vessel not under command (two balls).

q: Motoring past a dredger working in the harbour approach, you see these shapes. What do you do?
answer: Keep clear — she is restricted in manoeuvre
why: Rule 18: ball-diamond-ball = restricted in ability to manoeuvre.

q: Under sail, you are converging with a deep-laden tanker showing this shape. What do you do?
answer: Keep out of her way — avoid impeding her
why: Rule 18(d): all but NUC and RAM avoid impeding a vessel constrained by her draught.

q: You are sailing like this with the engine running in gear. What do you hoist?
why: Rule 25(e): under sail and engine, show a cone apex down; you are power-driven.

q: You are under sail alone, on port tack. This yacht on starboard tack is crossing your course. Who keeps clear?
why: Rule 18: the cone shows she is motor-sailing, so she keeps clear of sail.

q: This vessel lies across your planned route into a Croatian bay. What do you do?
answer: Keep well clear — she is aground in shallows
why: Rule 30(d): three balls = aground; there is shallow water round her.

q: You motor into a bay and see this yacht ahead. How do you pass it?
answer: Keep clear of its bow — its chain runs out ahead
why: A black ball means at anchor; its chain runs forward from the bow.

figure.note: Yacht ahead of you in the bay

q: You have lifted the anchor and are motoring out of the bay. What do you do with this?
answer: Lower it — it says you are at anchor
why: The ball means at anchor; take it down as soon as you are under way.

ru.Your boat, anchor just lifted: Ваша яхта, якорь только что поднят
